title: Sales Desk Pricing Policy — Continuum Backup & Recovery Orders, Contracted Rates, Onboarding Fee and Tier Changes
content:
A Continuum Backup & Recovery plan is ordered for one tier with at least the tier's minimum protected items and, where the tier's entry gate sets one, the minimum number of servers, for a term the tier offers. A tier whose list of supported compliance frameworks does not list the client's compliance framework cannot be ordered or moved to, because its retention does not meet that framework.

## 1. Conditions of an order

| Condition | What satisfies it |
|---|---|
| One tier | The order names a single tier |
| Protected items | At least the tier's minimum protected items at order |
| Servers | Where the tier's entry gate sets a minimum number of servers, at least that number |
| Term | A term length among the tier's offered terms |
| Compliance | The client's compliance framework, as declared on the client's profile, is listed among the frameworks whose retention the tier meets |

The compliance condition applies equally to a tier the plan is moved to.

## 2. Contracted rates

Each contracted rate — per server, per workstation and per Microsoft 365 user — is the tier's list rate for that class reduced by a single total discount percentage, rounded half up to the cent. The total discount percentage is the tier's term discount for the term ordered plus, when the client holds a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement whose status is active and whose tier rank is at least the tier's lowest qualifying ClearPath rank, the tier's ClearPath bundle discount. The two discounts are added together and the total is applied once to the list rate; the reduced rate is then rounded half up to the cent, separately for each class of item.

Where the client holds no ClearPath agreement meeting both parts of that condition — status active, and rank at least the qualifying rank — the total discount percentage is the term discount alone.

**Worked example (hypothetical figures only).** Take a hypothetical list rate of 10.25 USD, a hypothetical term discount of 5 percent and a hypothetical ClearPath bundle discount of 7.5 percent, for a client whose ClearPath agreement is active and at a qualifying rank.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| Total discount percentage: 5 percent plus 7.5 percent | 12.5 percent |
| List rate reduced by 12.5 percent: 10.25 USD multiplied by 87.5 percent | 8.96875 USD |
| Rounded half up to the cent | 8.97 USD |

If the same client's ClearPath agreement were not active, the total discount would be 5 percent, and the rate 10.25 USD multiplied by 95 percent, that is 9.7375 USD, rounded half up to 9.74 USD.

## 3. Onboarding fee

The onboarding fee is the tier's onboarding fee per server multiplied by the contracted servers, but never less than the tier's minimum onboarding fee. It is invoiced on the order date. Tiers with a zero fee post nothing.

**Worked example (hypothetical figures only).** With a hypothetical fee of 100 USD per server and a hypothetical minimum of 500 USD: an order with 3 contracted servers gives 300 USD, which is below the minimum, so the onboarding fee is 500 USD; an order with 8 contracted servers gives 800 USD, which is above the minimum, so the onboarding fee is 800 USD.

## 4. Tier changes

Upgrades take effect on the first day of the next calendar month after the client's signature, at the new tier's rates. Downgrades take effect only at renewal. A tier change may take effect only while the plan status is active.

| Kind of change | When it takes effect | Rates after the change |
|---|---|---|
| Upgrade to a higher tier | The first day of the next calendar month after the client's signature | The new tier's rates |
| Downgrade to a lower tier | Only at renewal | — |

The status condition is read from the plan's own record in the system at the moment the change would take effect; only the status active satisfies it. When a tier change takes effect, the plan records the new tier and the new server, workstation and Microsoft 365 user rates.

**Timing example (hypothetical date).** A client signs an upgrade on the 12th of a month. The upgrade takes effect on the 1st of the following month, provided the plan status is then active.
